title: 学習理論
subtitle: Machine Learning
educationalGoal: Artificial Intelligence is becoming increasingly important in various areas of the ICT society. This course aims to have students master basic technologies related to artificial intelligence, neural network, and deep learning.
advice:
This course covers the basic to application of deep learning, which is one of important technologies for realizing intelligent systems.

Students will learn the basic techniques for various deep learning and build and evaluate applications.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable for students to have sufficient knowledge in mathematics (especially regarding differential and integral calculus, linear algebra, probability etc.) and programming skills with Python.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic concepts of classification and recognition.
Be able to understand and implement algorithm of clustering.
Be able to understand and implement algorithm of perceptron.
Be able to understand and implement three layers of neural network.
Be able to understnd deep learning and its applications.

              学習・教育目標

              1.Classification and recognition
2.Classification algorithms
3.Perceptron
4.Neural network
5.Deep learning

              Artificial Intelligence is becoming increasingly important in various areas of the ICT society. This course aims to have students master basic technologies related to artificial intelligence, neural network, and deep learning.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course covers the basic to application of deep learning, which is one of important technologies for realizing intelligent systems.

Students will learn the basic techniques for various deep learning and build and evaluate applications.
